name: Orlando International
subtitle: Stand assignment and push control for Airsides 1-4 and South Terminal C (Charlie Ramp)
source: Stand positions, headings, taxiways, aprons and buildings from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), gate list, frequencies and procedures from the Jeppesen 20-9B/20-9C/20-9F charts (user-supplied). The chart frame is generated: north up, 1.5 m per pixel, linear in lat/lon. Gates OSM does not name (43, 59, 85, the 239 and 254 hardstands, 250-253 and the RON spots) are placed from the charts: 20-9B/9C from their grids, corrected by their OSM neighbours' label offsets; 20-9F (not to scale) by an affine fit to the stands both have.

airlinesSource: Approximate, from flymco.com and airport guides: Southwest on Airsides 1 and 3; Delta on Airside 4; American on Airside 2; United, Spirit and Frontier on Airside 3; JetBlue, Breeze and most international carriers at South Terminal C. Worth checking against current use. Charlie Ramp hardstands (239, 254) and the RON spots are not given out automatically.
notes: Departures from Airsides 1 and 3 (gates 1-59): Ground Control 121.8 on initial contact, unless advised by ATIS.
Departures from Airsides 2 and 4 (gates 60 and higher): Ground Control 126.4 on initial contact, unless advised by ATIS.
South Terminal C (Charlie Ramp 129.65): arrivals enter from B via B11, B12 or B13 (IN); departures leave on E1 northbound (OUT). Transition control points 1-3.
Twy J3 and J4 restricted to wingspan less than 118 ft (36 m).
Aircraft parked on the Airside 2 centerline west of Twy G1 / south of J3, and on the Airside 4 centerline north of E4, between 2200 and 0700 LT.
